text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're about halfway through<n>summer camp, and
we've just<n>finished another solid day of training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you happen to have<n>some time after
this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's somewhere I was hoping we<n>could go
together. If you don't mind,<n>how about it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's unusual for her to invite me to<n>something. I
wonder where she's<n>taking me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As we're waiting at the bus stop in<n>front of camp,
crowds of students<n>dressed in yukata pass by.

text_block_list.name: Students in Yukata
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do first? Maybe<n>takoyaki and...
oh, the shooting<n>gallery! After we look around a
little,<n>we should hurry and save a spot! I<n>can't wait
for the fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hear that? I guess there's a festival<n>going on
nearby. And they're doing<n>fireworks too.
choice_data_list: Is that not where we're going?
Is that not where we're going?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: (The sputtering of a bus draws near.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's us, that bus right there.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew, here we are. Reception is... ah,<n>thataway.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I spot people<n>writing messages
and drawing<n>pictures on sheets of traditional<n>paper,
then making them stand<n>upright with bamboo
sticks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm glad you think so... It<n>seemed like
something you would<n>like, so I thought it might be
fun to<n>come out here together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder what I should<n>wish for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe this sort of thing is best<n>kept secret.
They say your wish is<n>more likely to come true that
way,<n>don't they?
choice_data_list: They sure do. Let's keep it a secret then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I'm thinking of my wish, all the<n>days we've
spent together replay in<n>my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute showed up in my life<n>just as I was
thinking I should give<n>up on being a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again, she inspired me<n>and reignited
my passion. Her drive<n>and tenacity stirred up
emotions in me<n>that had lain buried.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And then, she chose me to be her<n>trainer. I couldn't
have been happier.<n>As long as I'm with her...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With each brushstroke, I capture my<n>pure and
honest feelings in this<n>moment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See that? There was a firefly just<n>now. That means
the stream must be<n>gentle around here. Trainer, this
looks<n>like a good spot.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The water is already dotted with<n>lanterns, their
reflections dancing<n>quietly in the night.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to release them. And off<n>we go.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our lanterns seem to be in no rush as<n>they leisurely
drift away from the<n>bank.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We watch in silence until they finally<n>join up with
the rest, their soft and<n>gentle lights now one with
many.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With our wishes sent off, Acute and I<n>slowly make
our way back to the bus<n>stop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Not a soul around. What a peaceful<n>night. And...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Chitter, chitter...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mm... You hear that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... And you know what that<n>means.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mhm, it sure is...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a lull in the conversation, and<n>I suddenly
notice my throat is<n>parched.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer. Wet your whistle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thirst quenched, I lose myself oncemore in the chirping of the insects.Everything about this moment feelsso comfortable and natural, almost as if...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Funny, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, I hope you won't laugh at me<n>for saying this,
but being here with<n>you, somehow I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that you and I have<n>been together
for a long, long time.
choice_data_list: I was just thinking the same thing.
I was just thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Were you now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Now how is it that we were<n>both thinking
the exact same thing?<n>That seems a little strange.
choice_data_list: I'd say it's entirely natural—inevitable, even.
I'd say it's entirely natural—inevitable, even.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're right. And you know...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Well, I think I'm sure of it now. The<n>bond that ties
us together will...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Maybe I didn't need to write<n>that after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's get going. Slowly, now...<n>side by side,
we'll take this road<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Later that evening...

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's water lanterns! They're so<n>pretty... Haha,
look! See those two<n>over there?

text_block_list.name: Boyfriend
text_block_list.text:
"May the two of us run strong<n>together forever
after." "May the<n>bond between my trainer and I
remain<n>strong forever after."

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Their wishes are the exact<n>same. I guess
that means they've<n>already come true.
